context: M7 o1. Corwin, 4th-floor corridor. Prentiss's man slides yellow paper under doors. Hollis watches.

lines.speaker: char.walter_hollis
lines.text: Shipmate! He's mailing us out! Thirty days, it says. Thirty days!

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Teddy! Just paperwork. Standard. Nobody's evicting anybody.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Thirty days is a conversation, not a deadline. Five hundred if you go early.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Take your paper off Mr. Hollis's floor.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: I'm in the moving business, Teddy. Moving's healthy. Ask Inez. She's thinking.
